summary: Kestrel Labs: hosted API timeouts when using structured output (JSON schema)
description:
Issue summary:
Kestrel Labs is seeing intermittent request timeouts (client-side 60s) when enabling structured output with a JSON Schema. Same prompts complete successfully when structured output is disabled.

Impact:
- Kestrel’s production workflow for contract analysis is failing intermittently.
- Reported failure rate ~8–15% depending on schema size.

Environment:
- Hosted API (OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
- Region: us-east
- Models: atlas-7b-instruct and atlas-13b-instruct

Steps to reproduce (customer-provided):
1) Send chat completion request with structured output enabled and a JSON Schema with ~40 properties and nested arrays.
2) Stream disabled.
3) Observe timeout on ~1/10 requests; retries often succeed.

Notes:
Customer says this started after they switched from tool-calling output to JSON Schema structured output (mid-July).
comments: Aisha Rahman (Support): Customer provided request IDs: req_7c2f..., req_9b11..., req_2a0d... All show long tail latency then gateway timeout.

Diego Fernandez (Runtime): Pulled traces. The slow requests correlate with schema validation + constrained decoding path. The model is spending a long time in token sampling with low temperature + many constraints.
Ethan Park (SRE): Confirmed p99 latency spike for route /v1/chat/completions when structured_output=true. Only visible on a subset of pods after autoscale. Suspect cache fragmentation.

Diego Fernandez (Runtime): Workaround: set max_output_tokens lower and simplify schema (avoid large anyOf/oneOf), or switch to tool-calling for now. We also rolled a config change: increased internal structured-output step timeout from 45s -> 75s for enterprise tier in us-east.
Aisha Rahman (Support): Customer confirmed improvement after config change; still sees occasional long responses on very large schemas but no longer hitting gateway timeout.
Resolution: Marking Resolved. Follow-up action: add a known-issue entry and instrument a separate metric for schema size vs constrained decoding wall time.
